title: 0.2.14 OTA and Cadence integration recovery
summary: This update fixes the OTA version judgment that could incorrectly offer an older same-version revision, restores the Cadence integration repair entry, and improves launcher diagnostics.
highlights: OTA no longer treats an older same-version revision as a new update.
The platform keeps the Repair Cadence Integration action after updating.
Insta360_HW.exe now uses a single instance and writes launcher logs to LOCALAPPDATA.
Update package verification and rollback were hardened to reduce broken-update risk.
compatibility: No data migration is required. Existing history, user plugins and local config are preserved.
